# Show frame numbers of layer<AvailableFrom v="4.0.535" />

Show the current frame number inside sequence layers in the Studio timeline. Defaults to `false`.

## CLI flag

```text
--show-layer-frame-numbers
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setShowLayerFrameNumbers(true);
```
